source: 564 Individual Roles
target: 564 Munera Individualia

source: 564 Individual Roles
target: 564 Munera Individualia

source: Looking at the specter suspected to be Iru, Juan Oro’s expression shifted.
target: Spectram, quem Iru esse putabatur, intuebatur; vultus Juan Oro mutatus est.

source: Back then, even though they had missed the optimal time for spirit channeling, they still managed to learn about the deaths on the first day and found items that could accurately pinpoint the target.
target: Illo tempore, quamquam tempus optimum ad spiritus evocandos amiserant, tamen didicerunt de mortibus primi diei et repererunt res, quae scopum exacte designare poterant.

source: Utilizing the Little Devil’s ability, they completed the summoning, but none of the deceased spirits appeared.
target: Donum Parvi Diaboli adhibito, evocationem perfecerunt, sed nulli spiritus defuncti apparuerunt.

source: This led them to believe that the human spirits that angered the sea would be devoured.
target: Hoc eos fecit credere spiritus humanos, qui mare iraserunt, devoratos iri.

source: No further attempts were made.
target: Nulla conamina ulteriora facta sunt.

source: Nearly a year later, the summoning had actually succeeded!
target: Paene post annum, evocatio vere successit!

source: Moreover, it appeared that Iru hadn’t drowned at sea but had been shot.
target: Praeterea videbatur Iru non in mari submersum esse, sed in eum telum iactum fuisse.

source: This was entirely different from the backlash caused by the failure of the sea prayer ritual!
target: Hoc omnino differebat ab ulteriore incommodo, quod ex defectione ritus precationis maris ortum erat!

source: Charname used Hermes to inquire about the spirit suspected to be Iru, but the target was already in a daze and couldn’t recall anything.
target: Charname Hermem ad rogandum de spiritu, qui Iru esse putabatur, usus est; sed destinatus iam in stupore versabatur et nihil recordari poterat.

source: Even his appearance had become blurry, assimilated by the environment.
target: Etiam eius species obscurata erat, ambiente absorpta.

source: Charname concluded the ritual and used Salah’s clothes, worn over many years, to summon the spirit of the other deceased.
target: Charname ritum conclusit et vestimenta Salah, per multos annos induta, ad spiritum alterorum defunctorum evocandum usus est.

source: This time, nothing happened.
target: Hoc tempore, nihil accidit.

source: Charname refrained from further attempts.
target: Charname ab ulterius conatibus abstinuit.

source: He extinguished the candle’s flame and dispelled the wall of spirituality.
target: Flammam candelæ exstinxit et murum spiritualitatis dissolvit.

source: In Highlander, he addressed Juan Oro, “The problem has become clearer.”
target: In Highlander, Juan Oro allocutus est: "Quaestio clarius facta est."

source: Juan Oro didn’t respond.
target: Juan Oro non respondit.

source: Instead, he turned to his grandson, Fernandez.
target: Immo, ad nepotem suum, Fernandez, se vertit.

source: “Take them out and send them home.”
target: "Eos extrahite et domum mittite."

source: “Instruct each of them.”
target: "Unicuique eos instruite."

source: “Alright.” Although Fernandez yearned to hear Charname’s conjecture and understand the subsequent events, he didn’t dare disobey his grandfather’s orders.
target: “Bene.” Quamquam Fernandez concupivit audire sententiam Charname et subsequenta intellegere, non ausus est praecepta avi sui contraria agere.

source: He hurriedly led the surviving sailors out of the lounge and closed the door.
target: Festinanter nautas superstes e conclavi duxit et ianuam clausit.

source: After a few moments, Juan Oro shifted his gaze to Charname, whose features didn’t stand out.
target: Post pauca momenta, Juan Oro oculos vertit ad Charname, cuius lineamenta non eminuerunt.

source: “Are you suggesting that the Iru who perished during the sea prayer ritual was an imposter?”
target: "Num putas Iru, qui per ritum precationis maris periit, impostorem fuisse?"

source: Charname asked with a smirk, “Why do you think the fake Iru is really dead? The others might have been swallowed by the sea, but not him.”
target: Charname subridens quaesivit: "Cur putas falsum Iru vere mortuum esse? Alii fortasse a mari devorati sunt, sed ille non?"

source: Disregarding the miraculous resurrection, nobody present could prove that the fake Iru had indeed fallen into the sea.
target: Resurrectionem miraculosa negellecta, nemo hic potuit probare falsum Iru revera in mare cecidisse.

source: Observing Juan Oro’s silence, Charname pressed on, “The real Iru should have been assassinated by those saboteurs days or even weeks before the sea prayer ritual.”
target: Silentiā Juan Oro observato, Charname pergit: "Verus Iru ab illis sabotoribus, diebus aut etiam hebdomadibus ante ritum precationis maris, interfectus esse debuisse."

source: No, he was more likely to have been kidnapped, killed by a gun a period after the sea prayer ritual completed; after all, the living cannot have their spirit channeled.
target: Non; potius verisimile erat ut post ritum precationis maris, aliquantisper, raptus et telis ictus interfectus esset; nam viventibus spiritus evocable non esse potest.

source: Later, someone disguised themselves as him and lived in Milo Village for a period.
target: Postea, aliquis se in eius effigie indutus, in vico Milo per tempus vixit.

source: Without arousing suspicion, they boarded the Governor of the Sea’s wedding ship as a sailor.
target: Sine suscitando suspicionem, in navem nuptialem Praefecti Maris ut nauta conscenderunt.

source: “Right, is Iru the kind with no living elders, no spouse, no kids, and not residing with siblings?”
target: "Recte, num Iru sit genus quod neque maiores vivos habeat, neque coniugem, neque liberos, neque apud fratres aut sorores degat?"

source: Juan Oro’s eyes narrowed as he spoke, “More or less."
target: Oculi Juan Oro contracti sunt, et inquit: "Fere ita."

source: Their grandmother passed away over a decade ago.
target: Avia eorum abhinc plus quam decem annos mortua est.

source: His parents, Children of the Sea, established a separate family.
target: Parentes eius, Filii Maris, familiam separatam condiderunt.

source: After reaching adulthood, they lost control of their powers, turning into pure sea spawn.
target: Ad adultam aetatem perventos, potestates suas amiserunt et in genuinam progeniem maris conversi sunt.

source: We had to send them back to the sea.
target: Eos ad mare redire oportuit.

source: “As expected, they picked the sailor with the least difficult disguise,” Charname remarked with a sigh.
target: "Ut exspectabatur, nauta cum dissimulatione leviori delectus est," Charname suspirans dixit.

source: Juan Oro frowned and said, “Yet, everyone boarding the ship undergoes a routine inspection by another sea spawn to confirm authenticity.”
target: Juan Oro frontem contraxit et dixit: "Attamen, quisque navem conscendens a alio progenie maris per inspectionem solitam ad veracem identitatem confirmandam subit."

source: Charname chuckled.
target: Charname subridens risit.

source: “As you said, it’s a routine inspection, and in this world, many disguises require specific methods or deeper identification to uncover.”
target: "Ut dixisti, inspectio solita est, et in hoc mundo, multa simulamina modis specificis aut indagatione altiore detegenda sunt."

source: Juan Oro nodded solemnly.
target: Juan Oro graviter annuit.

source: Charname kindly suggested with a hint of flaunting, “Next time, it might be wise to draw blood from everyone boarding the ship and compare it to their closest relatives.
target: Charname beniter, cum levitatione ostendendi, suadet: "Proximo tempore, sapienter erit sanguinem ex omnibus navem conscendentibus extrahere et cum cognatis proximis comparare.

source: It could reveal their true bloodline.”
target: Illud veram eorum sanguinis originem detegere posset."

source: “That’s an idea,” Juan Oro tersely acknowledged.
target: "Id consilium est," Juan Oro breviter agnovit.

source: Over the centuries, the sea prayer ritual had encountered no issues, so they hadn’t considered refining the details.
target: Per saecula, ritus precationis maris nullas difficultates habuerat, ideoque singularia non concocta censuerunt.

source: Juan Oro inquired, “What do those who disrupted the ritual want?”
target: Juan Oro rogavit: "Quid volunt illi qui ritum perturbaverunt?"

source: “We’re not certain either,” Charname shrugged, glancing towards the curtained window that led to the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: "Nec nos certi sumus," Charname umeris iactans, aspiciens versus fenestram velamentis opertam, quae ad domicilium Praefecti Maris ducebat.

source: Juan Oro sensed a hint in Charname’s allusion to something Louis Berry had mentioned earlier.
target: Juan Oro sensum invenit in allusione Charname ad aliquid, quod antea a Ludovico Berry dictum erat.

source: He subtly nodded and added, “When this year’s sea prayer ritual succeeds, we’ll release Miguel and allow him to live in Torres.
target: Subtiliter annuit et addidit: "Cum ritus precationis maris huius anni successerit, Miguel dimittemus et ei licebit in Torres vivere.

source: By then, the failure of last year’s ritual won’t remain a secretive burden.”
target: Tum defectus ritus anni priori non permanebit ut onus arcanum.

source: There’s no need for us to harm Miguel.”
target: Non opus est nobis Miguel laedere."

source: “Miguel?” Charname inquired thoughtfully.
target: "Miguel?" Charname cogitato quaesivit.

source: “He’s the false Governor of the Sea.
target: "Ille falsus Praefectus Maris est.

source: He used to work for the Fisheries Company, and his lineage traces back to Milo Village,” Juan Oro explained succinctly.
target: Olim pro Societate Piscatoria laboravit, et stirps eius ad Vicum Milo redegit," succincte explicavit Juan Oro.

source: Charname diverted his gaze, a faint smile gracing his lips.
target: Charname oculos avertit, et leviter risum in labiis suis exhibens.

source: “He’s had his year of indulgence.
target: "Annum indulgentiae suæ habuit.

source: Fear may linger, but everything comes with a price.”
target: Timor manere potest, sed omnia pretium habent.”

source: The companion of the great adventurer paused, curiosity lighting up his eyes.
target: Socius magni viatoris subsistebat, et curiositas oculos eius illuminabat.

source: “Did your ancestor come from the depths of the sea, or did ordinary fishermen suddenly gain inspiration and enlightenment, mastering the art of pleasing the sea and gaining its favor?” he inquired.
target: "Num maior vester ex abyssis maris ortus sit, an piscatores simplices subito inspirationem ac illuminatiam adepti, artem mari placendi atque eius gratiam obtinuerint?" inquit.

source: Juan Oro took a moment of silence before responding, “We don’t know.
target: Juan Oro paulum silentium tulit antequam respondit: "Nescimus.

source: Both possibilities are equally plausible.
target: Utraque possibilitas aequaliter verisimilis est.

source: Milo Village was once eradicated by the Earth Mother Church.
target: Vicus Milo olim ab Ecclesia Matris Terrae exterminatus est.

source: Many legacies were severed, and we’re left clueless about our ancestors’ origins.
target: Multae hereditates disiectae sunt, et de originibus maiorum nostrorum ignoramus.

source: On a personal note, I lean towards the second theory.
target: Quoad me, secundam theoriam praefero.

source: We’re different from typical sea spawn.
target: Nos a progenie maris ordinaria differtur.

source: The children we bear initially resemble humans.
target: Filii quos procreamus initio hominibus similes sunt.

source: It’s only as they absorb more of the sea’s power that they transform into humanoid lizards.
target: Modo, cum potentiam maris amplius absorberent, in lacertas humanoides se converterent.

source: Additionally, while our strength weakens, theirs does not.”
target: Praeterea, dum nostra robur debilitatur, eorum non fit.

source: Charname nodded in agreement.
target: Charname consensum annuit.

source: “I’m inclined to think the second scenario is more likely too.”
target: "Secundam rem etiam verisimiliorem esse puto."

source: He then asked, “Have all traces of Milo Village’s ancestors truly been erased?
target: Deinde quaesivit: "Num omnia vestigia maiorum Vicī Milo vere exstirpatum sint?

source: Is there no evidence left?”
target: Num nullae probationes remanserunt?"

source: Juan Oro studied Charname for a moment before revealing, “There’s some residual evidence in the underground chamber of the Governor of the Sea’s residence, but it’s just symbols and patterns.
target: Juan Oro aliquantisper Charname inspectus, deinde revelavit: "Aliqua residualia probatione in camera subterranea domicilii Praefecti Maris inveniuntur, sed tantum sunt symbola et figurae.

source: They’re meaningless and indecipherable.
target: Nullum sensum habent atque indecripta sunt.

source: If you want to see them, wait until the vigil ritual.
target: Si ea videre vis, exspecta usque ad ritum vigilii.

source: But aren’t you concerned about the risk of exposing our collaboration by going to the Governor of the Sea’s residence now?”
target: Sed num non solliciti estis de periculo, quod societatem nostram patefacere conemur, nunc ad domicilium Praefecti Maris eundi?

source: “Fair point.”
target: "Recte dicis."

source: After obtaining other details, Charname abruptly receded into the shadows in the corner and vanished.
target: Post alias notitia adeptus, Charname subito in umbras anguli recedens evanuit.

source: Juan Oro watched as the great adventurer’s companion disappeared and released a slow sigh.
target: Juan Oro observavit, dum comes magni viatoris evanuerat et lente suspiravit.

source: He sensed a storm brewing around Port Santa.
target: Sentivit tempestatem circa Portum Santa imminentem.

source: In the master bedroom of the fifth-floor suite at Solow Motel.
target: In cubiculo principali suite quinti tabulati apud Solow Motel.

source: Emerging from the shadows, Charname adorned the silver Lie earring behind his left ear.
target: Emergens ex umbris, Charname ornavit anulum argenteum "Lie" post auriculam sinistram.

source: His eyes swiftly transformed, becoming as clear as a lake, and his flaxen-tinted hair cascaded over his shoulders.
target: Oculi eius celeriter mutati sunt, evincentes ut lacus, et capilli flavis coloribus tincti super humeros decurrebant.

source: Franca, still radiating astonishing charm despite her male attire, tossed the earring back to Lumian.
target: Franca, adhuc admirabilem gratiam efferens, licet vestimenta virilia gereret, anulum ad Lumian reiecit.

source: She retrieved a black rubber band from her pocket and tied her long hair into a high ponytail.
target: Ex sacculo suo fasciam elasticam nigrum extraxit et capillos longos in colem altum alligavit.

source: “I’ve discovered traces of Bard!” the Demoness of Pleasure exclaimed with joy.
target: "Vestigia Bard detexi!" Demonissa Voluptatis cum gaudio exclamat.

source: “Why Bard and not the other two?”
target: "Cur Bard et non reliquorum duorum?"

source: Lumian sat in an armchair in front of the desk, tightly drawn curtains behind him.
target: Lumian in solio ante mensam sedebat, et post eum stringebant cortinae.

source: Deliberately returning to Trier and bringing Franca to Port Santa for her assistance, Lumian believed himself inferior to the Demoness of Pleasure in divination and spirit channeling.
target: Causim ad Trier rediens et Francam ad Portum Santa pro auxilio adducens, Lumian se inferiori Demonissae Voluptatis in divinatione et spiritus evocando esse putavit.

source: Rather than wasting the truth serum, he sought Franca’s direct help.
target: Quamquam serum veritatis non consumpsit, auxilium directum Francae petivit.

source: Additionally, he wanted Franca to assume the guise of his other identity, completely separating “him” from the adventurer Louis Berry.
target: Atque insuper, voluit Francam induere personam alterae identitatis suae, eum a viatore Ludovico Berry omnino segregans.

source: This would enable him to deceive those secretly monitoring him and potentially execute future deceptions.
target: Hoc ei licebit eos, qui eum occulte speculabantur, decipere et fortasse futuras fallacias efficere.

source: Franca shared her findings from the spirit channeling today and the completed conversation.
target: Franca communicavit inventa sua ex hodierno spiritus evocando et sermonem completum.

source: “The fake Iru must first possess powers akin to a Faceless’s, followed by adept thieving skills.
target: "Falsus Iru primum potestas similes Faceless habere debet, deinde peritiam furtandi subsequens.

source: Long ago, I Know Someone mentioned that Bard is a Sequence 6 Prometheus of the Marauder pathway.
target: Iamdudum, quidam notus dixit Bard esse Sequenciam VI Promethei ex via Maraudantium.

source: It’s highly likely he’s even stronger now.
target: Valde verisimile est eum nunc etiam fortiorem esse.

source: If others hadn’t confirmed that Loki wasn’t involved in last year’s sea prayer ritual prank, at least not openly, he would have been the most suitable to impersonate Iru.
target: Si alii non confirmassent quod Loki in iocum ritus precationis maris anni praeteriti, saltem non palam, ille aptissimus fuisset ad Iru impersonandum.

source: Now, the probability of Iru being Bard is higher.
target: Nunc, verisimilitudo ut Iru sit Bard augescit.

source: As a Mid-Sequence Marauder Beyonder, perhaps he possesses an item similar to Lie.
target: Ut mediocris ordinis Maraudantium Beyonder, fortasse rem similem "Lie" possidet.

source: Maybe he prayed to that Celestial Worthy, undergoing a change in physique and appearance.
target: Fortasse illi ad Illum Caelestem Dignum oravit, mutationem in forma corporali et specie subiens.

source: Additionally, he could be imbued with mystical anti-divination and anti-prophecy traits.
target: Praeterea, possit imbui proprietatibus mysticis, oppositis divinationi et prophetiae.

source: Marauder is one of the three pathways most easily influenced by Celestial Worthy.”
target: Maraudarius est unus ex tribus viis, quibus Illum Caelestem Dignum facile influere potest.”

source: Lumian listened quietly, and a smile gradually formed on his face.
target: Lumian tranquille audivit, et risus paulatim in facie eius oratus est.

source: “Bard’s role and purpose in last year’s ritual are essentially clear.
target: "Munus et propositum Bard in rito anni praeteriti fere clarum sunt.

source: He disguised himself as a sailor, boarded the ship, stole the genuine ceremonial ring, and replaced it with a fake one.
target: Se tamquam nauta simulans, navem conscendit, verum annulum caerimonialis furatus est, et illud falso substituit.

source: Then, he willingly leaped into the sea, feigning his death to make his escape!”
target: Deinde, libenter in mare saltavit, mortem simulans, ad effugium suum fugiendum!”

source: Lumian paused briefly before continuing, “The question now is, what roles did Mad Lady and Ultraman play in this matter?
target: Lumian breviter cessavit antequam pergeret dicens: "Nunc quaestio est: quaecumque munera Mad Lady et Ultraman in hac re gesserunt?

source: So far, their presence doesn’t seem to affect the final failure of the sea prayer ritual.”
target: Adhuc, eorum praesentia videtur non influere in defectum finalem ritus precationis maris.

source: Franca pursed her lips and paced back and forth.
target: Franca labra contraxit et iter faciens circum ambulavit.

source: “Mad Lady might handle receiving and communication.
target: "Mad Lady fortasse res accipiendas et communicandas administrare potest.

source: For instance, after Bard jumped into the sea, she could ‘teleport’ over and whisk him away to prevent him from being consumed by the tumultuous sea.
target: Exempli gratia, postquam Bard in mare saltavit, illa eum "teleportare" potuit et abripere, ne ab intimo mari tumultuoso devoraretur.

source: Only a Traveler possesses such an ability.
target: Solum Viator talem facultatem habet.

source: Ultraman is likely responsible for providing information about the sea prayer ritual and devising the corresponding plan.
target: Ultraman verisimiliter responsalis est pro informatione de rito precationis maris praebenda et consilium congruens excogitandum.

source: But that can’t be all.
target: Sed id non omnia esse potest.

source: He probably has other roles…”
target: Forte alia etiam munera habet…

source: Lumian leaned back in his chair, stroking his chin thoughtfully.
target: Lumian in sella sua recubuit, mentum diligenter perlustans.

source: “I concur with your hypothesis about Mad Lady, but according to the information we have, entering those special waters requires guidance from the Children of the Sea, following a specific route.
target: "Hypothesim tuam de Mad Lady assentior, sed secundum notitiam nostram, ad ingressum illarum aquarum specialium ducatio a Filiis Maris necessaria est, sequendo iter determinatum.

source: How did Mad Lady ‘teleport’ inside?
target: Quomodo Mad Lady intus se "teleportavit"?

source: Was she lurking on the ship?
target: Num in nave insidiabat?

source: Or does Bard carry some special coordinates with him?
target: An Bard quaedam signa specialia secum fert?

source: It’s certainly not a physical item; otherwise, it would have been discovered.
target: Certe, non res physica est; alioquin deprehensa fuisset.

source: As for Ultraman, I’ve always suspected he’s a native of Port Santa with a profound understanding of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Quoad Ultraman, semper suspicatus sum eum indigena Portus Santae esse, et ritum precationis maris penitus intellegere.

source: He likely orchestrated the prank last year.”
target: Forte iocum anni praeteriti condidit.”

source: At this point, Lumian stood up.
target: Ad hunc punctum, Lumian surrexit.

source: “My intuition suggests that if we can uncover Ultraman’s actions in last year’s prank and identify his role beyond being the mastermind, we can discern April Fool’s true motives in this matter!”
target: "Intuitio mea suadet, si actus Ultraman in ioco anni praeteriti detegere possimus et eius munus ultra moderatoris agnoscamus, veros Aprilis Folli propositos in hac re discerere poterimus!"
